COMPONENT_GRAPH.architecture_style: single-process Go edge runtime with immutable serving generations, serialized reconciliation, lifecycle-safe shared runtime objects, explicit data/operator planes and durable recovery

identity_contract.endpoint: pool id + canonical endpoint + transport compatibility; accepted remove/re-add creates a new incarnation
identity_contract.pool: stable pool id + semantic compatibility fingerprint
identity_contract.source: source identity + monotonic revision + content digest

COMPONENT_GRAPH.publication_contract: validate, compile, recheck source fences, reconcile runtime state, prepare durable checkpoint body and atomically publish one complete snapshot before acknowledgement

DATA_VOLUME_PLAN.plan: varied routes, pools, endpoints and independent source snapshots

outputs.SCALE_FIT: large_system_strict: multi-package runtime exceeds the 3000 substantive reachable LOC floor and supports 30 connected defect manifestations across six root-cause clusters without padding.

STATE_MODEL.authority: accepted per-source revision/digest fences and accepted merge material advance only with successful generation publication
STATE_MODEL.durability: checkpoint body is durable before CURRENT authority replacement; recovery verifies current then falls back to prior valid generation before provider admission
STATE_MODEL.endpoint_runtime: continuously present compatible canonical endpoints preserve runtime state; remove/re-add creates a new incarnation
STATE_MODEL.serving: one immutable complete RuntimeSnapshot is atomically published and request-held for matching, retries and failover
